description: Fetch historical OHLC bars for a 6-character FX pair (e.g. EURUSD) over a time range at a chosen interval (default 1m); volume is always 0 for OTC spot forex. Large ranges are size-capped (watch for the _truncated note) — narrow the range or paginate with cursor/limit. For the current rate use last_quote.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339 (UTC). Required.

name: forex_bars
title: Forex OHLC bars
